newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada employment insurance claims fall in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Canada employment insurance claims fall in Feb.

text.p: The number of Canadians who applied for regular employment insurance benefits declined 6.2 percent in February to 226,000 from 241,000 in January, Statistics Canada said on Tuesday.
The largest declines in February were in Ontario, with a fall of 5.6 percent, and Quebec, down 6.3 percent.

Regular benefit payments fell 1.5 percent in February to C$755 million, StatsCan said. Eight provinces and the Northwest Territories recorded declines, with the largest drop in Quebec, falling 4.8 percent.
The estimated number of Canadians who received regular employment insurance benefits declined for a fifth consecutive month in February, down 3.3 percent to 597,000, the federal agency said.
